components.name: Volley Rack
components.blurb: Three munitions to the salvo, one requisition form to the munition. The ammunition budget has been 'reviewed'.
components.quirk: Three small missiles a salvo (+50% damage a second over the Artemis), but each salvo spends 1.5 missiles: the Concord pay for it in ammunition and cost.

components.name: Concord Railgun
components.blurb: Rated for 'decisive engagement'. Charges slowly, the way a decision does, then settles the matter in one go.
components.quirk: A rail slug that pierces 2 at 1500 px/s and hits for 6, but it charges 1.5 times as long as a Mk2 pulse.

components.name: Flak Screen
components.blurb: Fills the lane with tin and good intentions. The manual is vague about what, exactly, it is a screen against.
components.quirk: A fast, accurate flak turret (accuracy 0.85) that shoots down enemy missiles within 300 px before it looks at any ship, but its pellets are weak against hulls.

components.name: Standard Reactor Plus
components.blurb: Standard Reactor, Plus edition: one more unit of power and twenty percent more invoice. The invoice is itemised; the power is not.
components.quirk: One more power than a Reactor Mk1 (9 against 8), for 20% more to build.

components.name: Concord Comms Array
components.blurb: Long-range listening, certified, with a registry lookup on everything it hears. The registry answers, eventually.
components.quirk: A radar that names every contact within 2400 px (the helm's own radar sees farther but names nothing), at 2 power.

components.name: Crew Quarters Deluxe
components.blurb: A bunk pod with a door that shuts and a pillow nobody was issued. Rested crews are said to be more productive. The audit is pending.
components.quirk: A powered pod that heals 10 hp a second (twice a bed) and makes the crew in its room work 5% faster, but it draws 1 power.
